items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: I didn't use a woman called, a lady called May... She was a good piano player

ctx.x: When you did have a piano player who would you use?
I didn't use a woman called, a lady called May Now her last name I don't know about She was a good piano player, she was a good musician, May She was a good piano player
